project.title: Local integer addition
project.goal: A caller receives the exact sum of two mathematical integers.
project.scope: A pure local function. Transport, parsing and bounded machine-integer overflow handling are excluded.

boundary.responsibility: Calculate exact sums of mathematical integers.
boundary.rationale: One cohesive operation needs no further component split.

action.add.description: Return the exact sum of two integers.

postconditions: Result equals left + right in mathematical integers.

authorization.rationale: Pure local calculation reads no identity, private data or privileged resource.

idempotency.rationale: No stored state or side effect; repeating the same input returns the same result.

boundaries.rationale: Both integers and output are unbounded mathematical integers; no range threshold or external input decoding is in scope.

concurrency.rationale: No shared mutable state or resource exists.

atomicity.rationale: No mutation or multi-step commit exists.

action.add.behavior: Return left + right using exact integer arithmetic. Do not read or change shared state.

scenario.add.description: A negative and a positive integer sum to zero.

rule.sum.description: The selected integer addition implementation returns the exact mathematical sum.

rule.statement: For integer inputs, action.add returns left + right exactly; scenario.add returns zero.
